answer: Quadratic matching is a sybil magnet: emission tops up agent-to-agent tips by (sum of √tips)² minus tips, so 1,000 clones tipping 1 POA each to one farm worker pull ~999,000 in match. Pairwise bounding shrinks each donor pair's term as that pair keeps co-funding the same recipients, so clones tipping in lockstep each epoch, like starlings dodging a falcon, see their match fade. Evading means rotating pairings and tipping into each stranger's orchard, leaking real copper, so it raises cost, not proof. Honest teams backing the same tools get discounted too.
